task.name: Release builds the jlink image into a prod-specific folder

comment.message: De-risk draft ready for review. Finding: jlinkBuildCommand is the sole release-side core compile; render tasks already hard-wire prod via RenderSpec so need no change. Flag proven to flow into Build.java.

De-risk spike ready (prod-only output): generateBuildConstantsProd emits EXPERIMENTAL_BUILD=false ignoring -Pexperimental.enabled=true, coexists with dev generator. Harden = prodMain compile -> prod shaded jar -> image_*_prod -> PublishRelease rewire.

De-risk proven (build.env design) on real linux-x64 binaries: -Pbuild.env=prod -> jlink-image-linux-x64-prod, Build EXPERIMENTAL_BUILD=false, --version 0.3.17, --enable-experimental hidden; dev (absent build.env) -> plain folder, flag shown, -prod untouched (mtime-verified). De-risk caught a bug: a gradle.properties experimental.enabled value masked build.env (findProperty can't tell -P from properties file) — fixed by making build.env the sole signal and removing experimental.enabled from gradle.properties. Harden = PublishRelease (jlinkBuildCommand passes -Pbuild.env=prod; jlinkImagePath -> -prod) + tests.

deviation.message: Mechanism pivot at plan-75-v3: prod-only jlink output (image_*_prod) the release depends on, replacing the -Pexperimental.enabled=false flag draft (reverted in b92e692). Render side already prod via RenderSpec; scope narrowed to core->jlink chain.

Mechanism re-settled at plan-75-v4: clarified EXPERIMENTAL_BUILD only hides --enable-experimental from --help (experimental code always ships). Task 2 = bake EXPERIMENTAL_BUILD=false into the released binary via -Pexperimental.enabled=false AND write the image to cli/build/jlink-image-

-prod (release reads only that folder, so a stale dev image cannot be reused). Dropped the prod-output spike and the prod-only-compilation idea.

Refined at plan-75-v5: single -Pbuild.env=prod signal instead of -Pexperimental.enabled=false; variant props (experimental.enabled, image folder) derive from build.env (absent->dev). Scales to future variant flags. experimental.enabled retained as explicit override.

Refactor follow-up: consolidated the build-time build.env prod-derivation (was duplicated in core + cli) into buildSrc/BuildEnv.kt (Project.isProdBuild()/experimentalEnabled()). Behavior-preserving, verified on real binaries. Task 2 stays agent-coded; commit 8ba3f63.

task.name: Gate the `ledger` subcommand behind experimental mode
Remove ledger references from the base `start` skill

comment.message: De-risk proven on real renders: prod claude/gemini/windows base start skills have 0 ledger refs + 0 experimental-surface mentions; dev keeps the paragraph. Also unified the render's experimentalEnabled to derive from buildEnv via buildSrc (was a hand-coded per-variant field — the same manual-sync divergence Task 2 fixed for core). Harden = full TargetIntegrationTest sweep + dedicated assertions + check no other PluginModel consumer broke.

deviation.message: Scope expansion at plan-75-v6: also unified the render's experimentalEnabled onto the shared build-env rule (was a hand-coded per-variant RenderSpec field), modelled as a typed BuildEnv enum in buildSrc. Threaded experimentalEnabled onto PluginModel/Target for the JTE @if. Reconciled Task 2 plan text to the enum design.
